extension.summary: Install and update the Kodi add-ons written by ksooo
extension.description: Add-on repository for the Kodi add-ons written by ksooo. Once it is installed, the add-ons it holds show up in Kodi's own add-on browser, and Kodi keeps them up to date on its own.
extension.summary: Die Kodi-Add-ons von ksooo installieren und aktualisieren
extension.description: Add-on-Repository für die von ksooo entwickelten Kodi-Add-ons. Nach der Installation erscheinen die enthaltenen Add-ons im Add-on-Browser von Kodi, und Kodi hält sie selbständig aktuell.
